facts.fact: The Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (PM-USP CSSS) is awarded on the basis of Class XII (Higher Secondary) Board results
facts.quote: The scholarships are awarded by Ministry of Education, Government of India on the basis of results of Higher Secondary / Class XII Board Examination.

facts.fact: The student must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream of their Board in Class XII
facts.quote: Students who are above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the respective Board of Examination in Class XII of 10+2 pattern or equivalent;

facts.fact: Gross parental/family income must be up to Rs 4.5 lakh a year; an income certificate is needed only for fresh applicants
facts.quote: Students with gross parental/family income upto ₹ 4.5 lakh per annum are eligible for scholarship under the scheme. Income certificate will be required only for the fresh applicants;

facts.fact: The student must be in a regular degree course, not correspondence/distance mode or a diploma course
facts.quote: Pursuing regular degree courses and not correspondence or distance mode or pursuing Diploma courses;

facts.fact: The college/institution must be recognised by AICTE and the regulatory body concerned
facts.quote: Pursuing courses at colleges/institutions recognized by All India Council for Technical Education and respective Regulatory Bodies concerned;

facts.fact: The student must not be availing any other merit or State scholarship, fee waiver or reimbursement scheme
facts.quote: Not availing benefit of any other merit scholarship schemes, State run scholarship schemes, fee waiver, reimbursement scheme.

facts.fact: A maximum of 82,000 fresh scholarships are given per year
facts.quote: A maximum of 82,000 fresh scholarships per annum are provided for pursuing graduate / postgraduate degree in colleges and universities and for professional courses, such as Medical, Engineering etc.

facts.fact: 50% of the scholarships are earmarked for girls
facts.quote: 50% of the scholarships are earmarked for girls.

facts.fact: Central reservation policy applies: 15% SC, 7.5% ST, 27% OBC and 5% horizontal reservation for students with benchmark disabilities
facts.quote: 15% seats are earmarked for SCs, 7.5% for STs and 27 % for OBCs and 5% horizontal reservation for students with Benchmark Disabilities (Disability of 40% or more) in all the categories

facts.fact: From FY 2022-23 the amount is Rs 12,000 a year for the first three years of graduation
facts.quote: Rate and Duration of Scholarship (from financial year 2022-23) The rate of scholarship is ₹12,000/-per annum at Graduation level for first three years of College and University courses

facts.fact: Rs 20,000 a year at post-graduation level
facts.quote: The rate of scholarship is ₹12,000/-per annum at Graduation level for first three years of College and University courses and ₹20,000/-per annum at Post-Graduation level.

facts.fact: Five-year/integrated professional courses get Rs 20,000 a year in the 4th and 5th year
facts.quote: Students pursuing professional courses, in case, where the duration of course is five (5) years/Integrated course will get ₹20,000/-per annum in the 4th and 5th year.

facts.fact: B.Tech/B.E. students get Rs 12,000 a year for years 1-3 and Rs 20,000 in the 4th year
facts.quote: However, students pursuing technical courses such as B.Tech, B.Engg. will get scholarship up to graduation level only i.e. ₹ 12,000 p.a. for 1st, 2nd and 3rd year and ₹20,000 in the 4th year.

facts.fact: The scholarship is paid by DBT into the student's own savings bank account
facts.quote: The scholarship will be disbursed directly into the savings bank accounts of the beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)

facts.fact: Renewal each year needs at least 50% marks in the annual examination and at least 75% attendance
facts.quote: For renewal of scholarship in each year of study, besides getting at least 50% marks in the Annual Examination, maintenance of adequate attendance of at least 75%, will also be the criteria.

facts.fact: Applications (fresh and renewal) are made online only on NSP, www.scholarships.gov.in
facts.quote: Beneficiaries/ Applicants under the scheme must apply online in the National Scholarships Portal (www.scholarships.gov.in) for the fresh/ renewal scholarships.

facts.fact: The scheme is run by the Department of Higher Education
facts.quote: PM-USP – Central Sector Scheme Of Scholarship For College And University Students (CSSS) (Merit Based Scheme) by Department of Higher Education

facts.fact: The NSP notice says CSSS renewal applications are open for 2026-27 (no fresh dates are given)
facts.quote: Renewal applications for the "PM-USP – Central Sector Scheme Of Scholarship For College And University Students (CSSS) (Merit Based Scheme)" and "PM USP Special Scholarship Scheme For Jammu Kashmir And Ladakh (Merit Based Scheme)" is currently open in NSP.

facts.fact: CSSS renewal: student applications till 31-10-2026
facts.quote: Scheme Open from (for Renewal): 01-06-2026 Student Application Open till (for Renewal): 31-10-2026

facts.fact: CSSS renewal: institute verification till 15-11-2026
facts.quote: Institute Verification Open till (for Renewal):15-11-2026

facts.fact: CSSS renewal: L2 (DNO/SNO/MNO) verification till 30-11-2026
facts.quote: DNO/SNO/MNO Verification Open till (for Renewal):30-11-2026
